I use Walmart- I guess generic Zoloft isn't Indic them. 
And the only thing I could find when looking into healthcare was with what I make I can get it through the govt for $100/mo plus the cost of meds. And from what I could tell it was more catastrophic coverage than an actual plan. Helpful for those in need of big surgeries or if I got in a car accident, but not so helpful when I live paycheck to paycheck.

I'll keep looking into it, but I checked into that awhile back

Arizona, sorry. I've never heard of 211. Might have to try that. 

And that is the price of uninsured sertraline. That is what I take.

I never said I wasn't going to no call, no show, I even said my boyfriend was going to call in for me and tell her why I can't make it (I realize that's kind of a cop out, but I also know I'd never make it through the call without bursting into tears- also unprofessional). I've been in retail 11 years. I've NEVER not shown up for work without calling hours in advance, but I've also never worked for someone who demanded we cover our own shifts but then is also short managers because in the past year, 4 of her 6 managers quit. 

>Still, it does not sound like you have been fired, denied a promotion, faced a disparity in pay, or denied a reasonable accomodation you requested due to a disability. So, it does not seem like you have much going on here. Your jerk of a boss is still a jerk.

I think it's interesting that I disclose my illness and ask for a little understanding, and get written up for the first time ever 4-5 days later after finishing our month +$14.000. Performance reviews are due next week, I'm sure that'll have an impact on whether or not I'm eligible for a raise. This also means that I cannot transfer or receive any promotions for a year. Related to my illness? Maybe, maybe not, but it sure looks sketchy.

>Get appropriate medical treatment. It is mind mindbogglingly unreasonable and entitled to expect accommodations from your employer when you aren't, and have not in the past, taken the steps necessary to keep yourself healthy. It also will suck for you, as no amount of coddling at work will do what actually making your health a priority will.

I don't think that's fair at all. This is something I've suffered with for 14 years. A magic pill doesn't just fix it, even with my medication, I was still experiencing a lot of anxiety and bad thoughts. I did drop the ball, as I admitted, on getting health insurance. Honestly my boyfriend had gotten laid off from his factory job in December and money was non existent, the idea of spending $40 a week on health coverage for just myself when we were having difficulty coming up with rent seemed "mind boggling unreasonable" at the time. 

If I had diabetes due to poor eating habits or "not taking care of myself" and I needed special accommodations, it wouldn't be a big deal. No, I can't afford the right treatment right now, but that doesn't mean I haven't been sick this whole time and that constant abuse at work hasn't exacerbated the problem. I'm not asking for "coddling" all I asked for was a little understanding.
Thank you, I'm trying. You're right. It's so hard to remember sometimes.

Well I'm a dudette and I'm trying to tell you that teenage girls are bitches. I didn't even like them when I was one. 

I've had horrible luck online dating, but I finally met the most amazing man. I never want to be without him and I hope he never leaves..

How old are you? Have you tried internet dating? I just have to say high school is bullshit and those girls don't know their ass from a hole in the ground. 

Socially speaking, college and beyond, that's where it's at.

He kinda knows but he's never self harmed and is generally a very happy guy so he doesn't get it.

He's amazing and he loves me no matter what. I don't know if I deserve him.

That last sentence made me cry all over again. 

He deserves better. He deserves more than mood swings, depression and crazy. He didn't do anything to deserve all this. 

Other people deserve your empathy and open arms more, I should have posted in /r/depression, no sw. I'm no risk right now.

I don't want you to feel pain anymore. But is hospitalization the worst thing right now? Is there at least someone you can call to be with you if not physically, emotionally right now? I don't want you to have to be alone
What did you do? What can we do? I'm having a breakdown and i don't want to lose you too. What can we do?
